target_pattern: Choose the right pronominal function in context: true reflexive with body-part articles, reciprocal in plural subjects, inherently pronominal chunks (quejarse de, arrepentirse de), passive se for impersonal/public statements, and meaning-change pairs like ir/irse and dormir/dormirse.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Treating every se verb as the same and translating word-for-word from English pronoun logic.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish uses pronominal forms for different functions. You choose the pattern by meaning, not by memorizing one English equivalent for se.
target_pattern_formula: true reflexive: pronoun + verb + definite article body part (me lavo las manos)
reciprocal: plural subject + se + plural verb (nos ayudamos)
inherently pronominal chunk: quejarse de, arrepentirse de
passive se: se + third-person verb agreeing with noun (se venden boletos)
meaning shift pairs: dormir vs dormirse, ir vs irse
natural_examples: Me lavo la cara antes de salir.
Nos ayudamos cuando hay mucho trabajo.
Me quejo del ruido del trafico.
Me dormi en el sofa y luego me fui tarde.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as directed.
drills: Base: Me lavo las manos. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Se cepilla los dientes. -> change subject to ustedes.
Base: Nos abrazamos. -> change to past (preterite).
Base: Se ayudan en clase. -> make it negative.
Base: Me quejo del ruido. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Nos arrepentimos del error. -> change to singular yo in preterite.
Base: Se venden boletos. -> change noun to singular la entrada.
Base: Se habla espanol aqui. -> change location to en mi empresa.
Base: Duermo ocho horas. -> change to fall asleep on the sofa.
Base: Me duermo tarde. -> change to nosotros and add casi siempre.
Base: Vamos al centro. -> change meaning to we leave now.
Base: Se van temprano. -> change to question with ustedes.
Base: Ellos se llaman por telefono. -> change to nosotros in present progressive.
Base: Me enojo facilmente. -> change to question with tu.
Base: Voy a sentarme aqui. -> change to can I sit here?

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the more natural option for each meaning.
prompts: I wash my hands. (Me lavo las manos. vs Lavo mis manos.)
We hug each other. (Nos abrazamos. vs Abrazamos.)
I complain about the delay. (Me quejo del retraso. vs Quejo del retraso.)
She regrets the decision. (Se arrepiente de la decision. vs Arrepiente la decision.)
Tickets are sold here. (Se venden boletos aqui. vs Venden boletos aqui.)
I sleep on the sofa. (Duermo en el sofa. vs Me duermo en el sofa.)
I fell asleep on the sofa. (Me dormi en el sofa. vs Dormi en el sofa.)
We go to the office at 8. (Vamos a la oficina a las ocho. vs Nos vamos a la oficina a las ocho.)
We are leaving now. (Nos vamos ahora. vs Vamos ahora.)
You all call each other every week. (Ustedes se llaman cada semana. vs Ustedes llaman cada semana.)

common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct transfer of English possessive body-part pattern.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Me lavo las manos antes de comer.

common_errors.mistake: Nosotros abrazamos when meaning each other

common_errors.why_it_happens: Inherently pronominal verb is treated as non-pronominal.
Verb agreement with plural noun is ignored.
Dormir and dormirse meanings are mixed.

common_errors.mistake: Voy ahora for I am leaving now
common_errors.why_it_happens: Ir and irse meaning contrast not applied.

common_errors.mistake: Se van a la oficina a las ocho used for we go there habitually
common_errors.correct_spanish: Vamos a la oficina a las ocho.

common_errors.mistake: Ustedes llaman cada semana when meaning each other
common_errors.why_it_happens: Reciprocal action is expressed without pronoun.
Reflexive infinitive is dropped in set chunk.
